proposal.quote: an enthusiastic supporter of the Rome–Berlin Axis
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage explicitly refers to the Rome–Berlin Axis as an existing alignment, matching the threshold for the Rome-Berlin alignment.

proposal.quote: the question of Spain had so profoundly separated the two countries that it would only be possible to review the situation when the Spanish war was finished
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The communiqué reports that Italy and France are profoundly separated and rules out arbitration or conferences, supporting the estranged-from-the-West condition.

proposal.quote: the stupid blunder of Mussolini in making his demand for Tunis, Corsica and Nice. This thoroughly aroused the French and unified the factions as they have not been unified for some years.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Mussolini's territorial demands against France and the French reaction show Italy estranged from the Western powers.

proposal.quote: This has been brought in in streams from Italy and Germany, particularly from Germany, for weeks. This is common knowledge.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: German and Italian war material flowing to Franco reports the Rome-Berlin alignment in joint support of the Spanish rebels.

proposal.quote: the absorption of Austria into the German Reich
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The austria threshold's annexed level is met because the note treats Austria's absorption into the German Reich as an accomplished state of affairs, though it does not recite the troop and reunification-law details.

proposal.quote: In addition to the anti-French press campaign reported in my 19, January 17, 7 p.m., this was obviously intended by the Italians to bring further pressure on the French.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Reports an anti-French press campaign and Italian pressure on France, i.e. Italy in an estranged posture toward the Western powers, meeting the estranged threshold.

proposal.quote: reports indicate that Hitler, encouraged by Ribbentrop, Himmler and others, is considering an attack on the Western powers as a preliminary to subsequent action in the east. ... His Majesty’s Government have carefully considered the situation in the light of these reports and have decided to accelerate as far as possible the preparation of their defensive and counter-offensive measures.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The January 1939 war scare: the government's own message treats German aims as possibly beyond revision (an attack on the Western powers) and responds with accelerated defensive and counter-offensive preparations while still seeking to deter Hitler by warnings, which is the 'uncertain' level rather than 'hegemonic' (the text still says it is 'impossible to speak of them with certainty').

proposal.quote: His Majesty’s Government have carefully considered the situation in the light of these reports and have decided to accelerate as far as possible the preparation of their defensive and counter-offensive measures.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The government records that, in view of a possible German attack, it is accelerating preparation of defensive and counter-offensive measures (and considers being ready for 'appropriate action' over Holland), meeting the 'wary' rule of preparation for a possible military answer; the passage is a decision reported in a confidential telegram rather than a public statement, hence medium confidence.

proposal.quote: the German Government are pressing for the conversion of the Anti-Comintern Pact into a pact pledging the signatories to give each other military assistance against unprovoked attack by a third power, that the Italian Government have agreed
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports as a fact in force the Anti-Comintern Pact with Germany, Italy and Japan as signatories, i.e. the pact concluded 25 Nov 1936 with Italy's accession, so the flag is true.

proposal.quote: since the breaking out of the conflict with China has not hesitated to manifest antipathy toward Japan
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Threshold: Japan's army engaged in a general war in China; the Japanese diplomat's letter treats the conflict with China as a fact in being at the document's date, though it is mentioned only in passing as the background to American opinion.

proposal.quote: will raise the embargo on arms which weighs on the Government of the Spanish Republic
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports an arms embargo in force against a belligerent (the Spanish Republic), the mandatory-embargo regime of the Neutrality Acts, which is the isolationist level.

proposal.quote: Bonnet said that he believed Germany did not desire war this spring.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The French Foreign Minister's statement treats German aims as not requiring war this year, matching limited rather than a hegemonic or uncertain Cabinet view.

proposal.quote: Jews remaining in Germany, including Austria and the Sudetenland
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The memorandum counts Jews in Germany including Austria, which reports Austria as included in Germany, though the specific troop presence and reunification law are not stated.

proposal.quote: Jews remaining in Germany, including Austria and the Sudetenland
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The memorandum counts Jews in Germany including the Sudetenland, which reports the Sudetenland as under German control, though the Munich cession itself is not stated.

proposal.quote: articles demanding French territory which have been appearing in the Italian press
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage reports Italian press demands for French territory, meeting the threshold for Italy being estranged from the West.

proposal.quote: war would be imminent if it were not for the hesitation created in Germany and Italy by the evolution of opinion in the United States and the attitude of the President and the American Government
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Daladier's ministerial statement treats war as imminent absent US deterrence, meeting the uncertain threshold illustrated by the Jan-Feb 1939 war scares.

proposal.quote: the war with China should come to an end
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: The passage refers to an ongoing war with China, meeting the threshold of Japan's general war in China.

proposal.quote: Chamberlain's idea is that he is going to go along, preparing and arming all the time, but assuming that he can do business with Hitler.
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Applied the limited threshold: the passage reports the Prime Minister's own view that German aims can be met by doing business with Hitler, while expressly distinguishing this from the Foreign Office's distrustful view.

proposal.quote: his hope that appeasement will still be worked out
proposal.rule: deepseek backend: Applied the appease threshold: the report describes the Prime Minister's policy as still seeking a settlement with Germany, with no standing commitment to fight for a third state reported.
